entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I think I need to return something? This VeloBand tracker. I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Yes, it's Anna Gable. The order number should be... VF789012.

Thank you, Anna. One moment. Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on January 19th. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... everything has been a mess. My husband had a sudden medical emergency and was rushed to the hospital. He needed an unexpected surgery.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope he is recovering well.

Thank you. With that, and his military deployment now postponed, we just won't be using it. I haven't even had a moment to think about this until now. I don't know what the policy is. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Anna. I completely understand. Let me just take a quick look at the return policy for your item.
Okay, I've checked our system, and it looks like you have nothing to worry about. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery.
Since you only received the band 6 days ago, you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you right now.
Oh! Really? That easily? That's... that's such a huge relief. Thank you so much. With everything going on, that's one less thing for me to worry about.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could make things a little easier for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on your account now. You should see it in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Charlie.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your husband a speedy recovery. Have a good day.
